message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries on global warming that you might find interesting:

| Title | Year | Synopsis |
|-------|------|----------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents a comprehensive overview of climate science and the urgent need for action. |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels around the world to witness the impacts of climate change and discusses solutions. |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC production that explains the science behind global warming, its effects, and policy responses. |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A collaborative film featuring various environmental experts discussing humanity’s relationship with Earth. |
| **“Our Planet” (Series)** | 2019 | While primarily a nature series, each episode highlights how climate change threatens ecosystems worldwide. |

These films are widely available on streaming platforms such as Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, or through educational distributors. Let me know if you’d like more details on any particular documentary or help finding where to watch it!
